timestamp_semantics: Monotonic logical publication time after the Campaign270 final validated state; not a market-data timestamp or host-wall-clock claim.
purpose: Freeze one finite zero-network concept-only catalog for externally observed stakeholder attention or demand before targeted repository content search. Campaign271 may preserve at most one concept for a later source-contract campaign, but may not define a factor, source adapter, direction, formula, threshold, current score or return trial.

sequence_disclosure.scope_observed: Tracked concept/frontier/source filenames for Campaign118-Campaign270 only.
sequence_disclosure.effect_on_catalog: The exact six-route catalog, priority order, decision rule and query families below were still frozen before any targeted repository content search. The preliminary filename inventory is recorded as Campaign271 infrastructure failure 004 and is not hidden or treated as scientific evidence.

concept_admission_gate.external_behavior_state: The route must observe stakeholder attention or demand outside issuer disclosures, financial statements, market prices, order flow, minute OHLCV/amount, facility hazards and the terminal industry-lifecycle families.
concept_admission_gate.point_in_time_identity: A later source contract must freeze issuer legal entity, historical brand/product/domain/app identity and effective ownership/association intervals without current-brand survivorship backfill.
concept_admission_gate.public_clock_and_revisions: A later source contract must prove public availability, sampling, revisions and archive reproducibility at the signal close for every 2019-2023 observation.
concept_admission_gate.complete_denominator: A later source contract must enumerate every eligible issuer, distinguish true zero attention from missing or unsupported coverage, and prove complete historical support before any factor value.
concept_admission_gate.single_route: Select at most the first route in the frozen priority order that is economically independent and not already present in repository evidence. Sibling metrics, platforms, query baskets, thresholds, windows and directions remain closed.
concept_admission_gate.no_value_stage: Campaign271 may inspect tracked repository metadata and prior terminal records only. It may not access provider or web responses, raw rows, candidate/comparator values, prices, returns or 2024-2025 stress values.
